propers.text:

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Beati Marci Evangelistae tui solemnitate tibi munera deferentes, quaesumus,
Domine: ut, sicut illum praedicatio evangelica fecit gloriosum; ita nos ejus
intercessio et verbo et opere tibi reddat acceptos. Per Dominum.

provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: the antecedent window does not carry a conclusion at this point; the 1962 prints "Per Dominum."; accents, ae/oe ligatures and word division differ throughout; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer and its pointing cannot be trusted at comma level. Corroboration: 1922 Mame at artifact PDF p. 689, alignment 0.91; 1604 at lines 45476-45482, alignment 0.60 (degraded-latin; corroboration only). Recorded limitation: The 1962 reading was settled on the facsimile page image; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer only and its letterforms and pointing were not verified on a page image (the 1862's images are not available to this lane, and the Mame's were not rendered for this entry). What was NOT checked: the Benziger conformed printing was used only as a boundary check on the extraction, never as a reading; no attempt was made to establish which of several possible loci in the antecedent is the 'original' one, since an order is not a contribution. This oration is one the Missal draws from a Common; the antecedent witness may print it at the Common, at another saint's day, or at both. That is a difference of position, not of words.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Tribuant nobis, quaesumus, Domine, continuum tua sancta praesidium: quo,
beati Marci Evangelistae tui precibus, nos ab omnibus semper tueantur
adversis. Per Dominum.
